generic.Defined scope/population: The named insured plus any subsidiary or affiliate carrying exposure on this submission
generic.In-scope period: Two most recent fiscal years of audited or reviewed financials plus current D&B data
generic.Required fields populated and valid: D-U-N-S, PAYDEX, Failure Score, current ratio, debt-to-equity and EBITDA trend all recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ratios recomputed from the attached statements match the figures keyed on the financial tab
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: D&B report and financial statements attached to the account file with pull date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bankruptcy, lien, judgment or going-concern flags logged with the underwriting response
generic.Test population: Every submission requiring financial assessment under the credit guideline for the class
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the grade lacks attached evidence or any adverse filing is left unaddressed
generic.Exception handling path: Unaudited or missing financials referred to the Senior Underwriter with acceptance reason recorded
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Graded A-D with a one-line justification and credit evidence attached on the account file
generic.Evidence location: Account financial tab in the underwriting workstation with the D&B report attached

steps.title: Pull the D&B report for the named insured in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Search LexisNexis Risk using the insured legal name, address and tax ID exactly as stated on the submission.
Confirm the matched entity is the insured itself and not a similarly named affiliate or parent.
Download the D&B report PDF and attach it to the account file in the underwriting workstation.
Done when the D&B report is attached to the account file with its pull date recorded.
verify: Check the attached report names the same legal entity shown on the submission.
Pass when the D&B report is on file with a pull date inside the guideline freshness window.

steps.title: Record D-U-N-S, PAYDEX and Failure Score on the workstation financial tab
sop: Open the account financial tab in the underwriting workstation.
Key the D-U-N-S number, PAYDEX score and Failure Score exactly as shown on the D&B report.
Record the report date alongside the scores so staleness can be judged later.
Done when all three D&B values and the report date are saved on the financial tab.
verify: Compare each keyed value against the attached D&B report page.
Pass when all three scores match the report with no transposition.

steps.title: Attach the two most recent financial statements to the account file
sop: Collect the two most recent audited or reviewed financial statements from the broker submission.
Confirm each statement carries the preparer name, period covered and audit opinion type.
Where only unaudited figures exist, record the reason unaudited figures were accepted.
Done when two statement periods are attached or the unaudited acceptance note is recorded.
verify: Check both attachments cover consecutive fiscal years for the named insured.
Pass when two periods are on file or an acceptance note explains the gap.

steps.title: Compute liquidity and leverage ratios in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read current assets, current liabilities, total debt and equity from the attached statements.
Compute current ratio and debt-to-equity for each of the two fiscal years.
Compute the EBITDA trend across the two years and record the direction and percentage change.
Done when all three metrics for both years are recorded on the financial tab.
verify: Recompute one ratio independently from the attached statement figures.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the recorded value.

steps.title: Flag adverse filings and record the underwriting response in the workstation
sop: Read the D&B legal and public filings section for bankruptcy, tax lien and judgment entries.
Read the audit opinion for any going-concern qualification.
Log each adverse item found with its date, amount and the underwriting response taken.
Done when every adverse item carries a recorded underwriting response.
verify: Cross-check the logged items against the filings section of the D&B report.
Pass when no adverse filing appears on the report without a logged response.

steps.title: Record the financial strength grade on the workstation financial assessment field
sop: Weigh the D&B scores, ratio results and adverse filings against the credit grading guideline.
Select the financial strength grade A to D supported by that evidence.
Enter the grade with a one-line justification naming the decisive metric.
Done when the grade and justification are saved on the financial assessment field.
verify: Read the justification against the recorded metrics and flags.
Pass when the grade is supported by at least one recorded metric or flag.

steps.title: Review the completed financial assessment before it feeds pricing
sop: Open the account financial tab and read the grade, metrics and adverse item log.
Challenge any grade that conflicts with the PAYDEX, Failure Score or leverage position.
Return the assessment for rework where evidence is missing or the grade is unsupported.
Done when the assessment is marked reviewed on the account file.
verify: Confirm the reviewer stamp and date are present on the financial tab.
Pass when the assessment carries a reviewer stamp and no open rework item.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every insurable location and operation on the submission schedule for this account
generic.In-scope period: Survey or inspection reports dated within the guideline age of 36 months of inception
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Construction, occupancy hazard grade, protection class and exposure distance held per location
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Locations carrying COPE attributes equal the location count on the exposure schedule
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Survey report and protection certificates attached with report date and surveyor named
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each open loss control recommendation marked accepted, rejected or made a subjectivity
generic.Test population: All surveyed locations plus any location where a survey was waived
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any location lacks COPE data or any open recommendation lacks a disposition
generic.Exception handling path: Stale or missing surveys routed to the Risk Engineer to order a new survey before terms
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hazard grade recorded with COPE per location and every recommendation dispositioned
generic.Evidence location: Risk assessment tab of the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Check survey currency on the account risk tab in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the account risk assessment tab and read the date of the most recent survey per location.
Compare each date against the 36 month guideline age measured to the policy effective date.
List locations with stale or absent surveys for re-order.
Done when every location is marked current survey or survey required.
verify: Recheck the oldest survey date on the list against the guideline age.
Pass when no location is left without a currency determination.

steps.title: Order replacement surveys for stale locations through the Risk Engineer
sop: Take the survey required list and raise a survey order for each location.
State the hazards to be examined and the target completion date on each order.
Log the order reference and expected return date on the account risk tab.
Done when each stale location has a logged survey order reference.
verify: Compare the count of orders raised against the survey required list.
Pass when order count equals the number of stale or missing surveys.

steps.title: Record COPE attributes per location in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read construction class, occupancy hazard grade and protection class from each survey report.
Record exposure distance to the nearest adjacent hazard for each location.
Key all four attributes against the matching location row on the risk tab.
Done when every scheduled location holds a complete COPE attribute set.
verify: Count location rows carrying complete COPE against the exposure schedule count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Verify sprinkler and alarm protection certification for each protected location
sop: Read the protection section of each survey for sprinkler coverage and alarm type.
Confirm central station certification is current for every location claiming alarm credit.
Attach the certificate or note the certification reference on the location row.
Done when each protected location shows a verified certification status.
verify: Spot check one certificate against the protection credit recorded for that location.
Pass when no protection credit exists without a verified certification.

steps.title: Disposition every open loss control recommendation on the account risk tab
sop: List each open recommendation from the survey with its assigned priority.
Mark each as accepted, rejected or to be carried as a policy subjectivity.
Record the reason for any rejection and the deadline for any subjectivity.
Done when no recommendation on the list remains without a disposition.
verify: Compare the dispositioned count against the recommendation count on the survey.
Pass when every survey recommendation carries a disposition.

steps.title: Score the risk control programme and record the hazard grade
sop: Assess housekeeping, hot work permit control, driver qualification and management of change.
Score each element against the risk control scoring guideline.
Record the overall hazard grade and the elements that drove it up or down.
Done when the hazard grade and its drivers are saved on the risk assessment tab.
verify: Read the grade against the recorded element scores.
Pass when the hazard grade follows the recorded scores under the guideline.

steps.title: Review the hazard assessment before it is relied on for terms
sop: Read the COPE data, protection verification and recommendation dispositions on the risk tab.
Challenge any accepted high priority recommendation lacking a compensating control.
Return the assessment where evidence or dispositions are incomplete.
Done when the assessment is stamped reviewed on the account.
verify: Confirm the reviewer stamp and date are recorded on the risk tab.
Pass when the assessment is stamped and carries no open rework item.

generic.Defined scope/population: All reported claims and exposures for the account across the loss runs held on file
generic.In-scope period: The five prior policy years developed and trended to the prospective policy period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Incurred loss, claim count, exposure base and on-level premium held for every policy year
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts and incurred totals in the exhibit tie back to the loss runs on file
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Excel exhibit saved to the account with LDF selection version and valuation dates shown
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Years distorted by a large loss flagged with the ex-large-loss ratio shown alongside
generic.Test population: Every policy year with loss data available for the account being rated
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any year lacks a stated LDF, trend rate or on-level premium basis
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or unusable loss years referred to the Pricing Actuary for a treatment decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exhibit shows development, trend and on-level basis per year and an all-years loss ratio
generic.Evidence location: Loss analysis exhibit attached to the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Load loss run data by policy year into the Excel loss analysis exhibit
sop: Open the loss analysis exhibit template in Microsoft Excel.
Enter paid, reserve and incurred amounts and claim counts for each policy year from the loss runs.
Record the carrier and valuation date against each year loaded.
Done when every available policy year row is populated with amounts and a valuation date.
verify: Sum the incurred column and compare against the loss run totals.
Pass when the exhibit total equals the loss run total for every year.

steps.title: Apply loss development factors to bring each year to ultimate
sop: Select the current LDF set for the line and record its version on the exhibit.
Apply the age-to-ultimate factor matching each policy year maturity.
Record the factor used beside each developed year so the derivation is visible.
Done when every policy year shows a developed ultimate loss and the factor applied.
verify: Recompute one year ultimate as reported incurred times the stated factor.
Pass when the recomputed ultimate matches the exhibit value.

steps.title: Trend losses and exposures to the prospective policy period
sop: Select the loss trend and exposure trend rates for the class and state.
State both rates on the exhibit with the source and effective date.
Trend each developed year forward to the midpoint of the prospective policy period.
Done when every year shows a trended loss and trended exposure with the rates stated.
verify: Check the trend period used for the oldest year against the prospective period midpoint.
Pass when trend periods run consistently across all years.

steps.title: Compute per-year and all-years loss ratios in the Excel exhibit
sop: Enter on-level earned premium for each policy year and note the on-level method used.
Divide developed trended ultimate loss by on-level earned premium for each year.
Compute the all-years weighted loss ratio across the period.
Done when per-year and all-years loss ratios are present with the on-level basis stated.
verify: Recompute the all-years ratio from the column totals.
Pass when the recomputed all-years ratio matches the exhibit figure.

steps.title: Compute claim frequency per exposure unit by year
sop: Select the exposure unit for the line such as per million payroll, per vehicle or per hundred revenue.
Divide the claim count for each year by that year trended exposure units.
Record the frequency series and the exposure unit definition on the exhibit.
Done when a frequency figure exists for every policy year with the unit stated.
verify: Recompute frequency for the most recent year from the counts and exposures shown.
Pass when the recomputed frequency matches the exhibit value.

steps.title: Flag large-loss distorted years and show the ex-large-loss ratio
sop: Identify any single claim above the large-loss threshold for the line.
Mark each affected policy year as distorted on the exhibit.
Recompute the loss ratio for those years excluding losses above the threshold.
Done when every distorted year shows both the gross and ex-large-loss ratio.
verify: Confirm the threshold used is the current large-loss threshold for the line.
Pass when each flagged year shows both ratios side by side.

steps.title: Publish the loss ratio and frequency exhibit to Power BI and the account file
sop: Refresh the Power BI loss analysis view against the completed exhibit data.
Attach the Excel exhibit to the account in the underwriting workstation.
Record the exhibit version and preparation date on the account.
Done when the exhibit is attached and the Power BI view reflects the same figures.
verify: Compare the all-years loss ratio in Power BI against the attached exhibit.
Pass when the two figures agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every location and exposure unit listed on the submitted statement of values
generic.In-scope period: The prospective policy term compared against the expiring term exposure basis
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Address, TIV, construction, occupancy, protection and year built held for every location
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Schedule TIV total reconciles to the premium base declared on the submission
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Statement of values file and geocoding output saved to the account with load date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed geocodes and TIV variances over five percent logged with the resolution taken
generic.Test population: All locations on the statement of values including those added mid-submission
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any location is ungeocoded or any variance over five percent is unexplained
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolvable addresses referred to the Underwriter for broker clarification before verification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All locations geocoded above street-level quality and TIV and exposure totals reconciled
generic.Evidence location: Exposure schedule attached to the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Load the statement of values into the Excel exposure schedule template
sop: Open the submitted statement of values and the exposure schedule template in Microsoft Excel.
Map each source column to the template fields for address, TIV, construction, occupancy and protection.
Load all location rows without dropping blank or duplicate entries.
Done when the template holds one row per location from the statement of values.
verify: Compare the loaded row count against the source location count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Complete missing location attributes on the schedule
sop: Filter the schedule for rows missing construction, occupancy, protection or year built.
Request the missing attributes from the broker and record the request date.
Populate each field on receipt and mark the row complete.
Done when no location row is missing a required attribute.
verify: Re-filter the schedule for blank required fields.
Pass when the filter returns zero rows.

steps.title: Geocode all locations and repair failed matches
sop: Run the geocoding routine over the full location list.
Review every result below street-level match quality and correct the address.
Re-run geocoding for corrected rows and record the final match quality per location.
Done when every location holds a street-level or better geocode result.
verify: Count locations with match quality below street level.
Pass when that count is zero.

steps.title: Reconcile schedule TIV against the declared premium base
sop: Total the TIV column on the completed schedule.
Compare the total against the premium base declared on the submission.
Explain and record any variance above five percent with the cause identified.
Done when the TIV total is reconciled or the variance is explained in writing.
verify: Recompute the TIV total from the schedule rows.
Pass when the total ties to the declared base or an explanation is recorded.

steps.title: Compare the exposure base against the expiring term
sop: Pull the expiring term payroll, sales, vehicle count or headcount from the prior policy record.
Compute the percentage change against the submitted exposure basis.
Raise a broker query for any change above twenty percent and record the answer.
Done when every exposure base movement above twenty percent carries a recorded explanation.
verify: List movements above twenty percent and check each has an answer logged.
Pass when no unexplained movement above twenty percent remains.

steps.title: Flag cat-exposed locations for aggregation review
sop: Overlay the geocoded locations against flood, quake and named-storm tier zones.
Flag every location falling in a cat-exposed zone on the schedule.
Send the flagged subset for exposure management aggregation review.
Done when all cat-exposed locations are flagged and submitted for aggregation review.
verify: Confirm each flagged location carries a zone designation.
Pass when the aggregation review acknowledges the flagged subset.

steps.title: Attach the verified exposure schedule to the account
sop: Save the completed schedule with the verification date and preparer name.
Attach it to the account record in the underwriting workstation.
Mark the exposure schedule requirement as verified on the submission.
Done when the verified schedule is attached and the requirement is marked complete.
verify: Open the attached file from the account and check it is the verified version.
Pass when the attached schedule carries the verification date and preparer.

generic.Defined scope/population: The single account under analysis and all its coverage parts being considered
generic.In-scope period: The current submission cycle up to the point the narrative is locked
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Operations, hazard profile, loss read, financial condition and risk quality score all present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Score stated in the narrative matches the score held on the account scoring field
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Narrative locked on the analysis tab with author and timestamp captured
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Residual concerns carried into terms listed with the subjectivity or exclusion that covers each
generic.Test population: Every account reaching the analysis stage in the underwriting workstation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the narrative omits the score, the appetite class or the guideline citation
generic.Exception handling path: Accounts outside the cited appetite class referred to the Senior Underwriter before the narrative locks
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Narrative with risk quality score and appetite citation recorded and locked on the account
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting analysis tab of the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Assemble the analysis inputs on the account in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the account and gather the exposure schedule, hazard assessment, loss exhibit and financial grade.
Confirm each input is the final version and not a superseded draft.
List any input still outstanding that would change the narrative.
Done when all four inputs are confirmed final or the outstanding items are listed.
verify: Check each input version date against the account record.
Pass when no superseded input is being relied on.

steps.title: Write the operations and hazard profile section of the narrative
sop: Describe what the insured actually does, where it operates and the scale of operations.
Summarise the hazard profile drawn from the COPE data and risk control scoring.
Name the specific hazards that drive the account risk character.
Done when both sections are written on the underwriting analysis tab.
verify: Check the hazard statements trace to the recorded hazard grade.
Pass when every hazard named appears in the risk assessment record.

steps.title: Write the loss experience and financial condition read
sop: Summarise the loss ratio and frequency read against the class benchmark.
State the financial strength grade and what drove it.
Draw both into a single view of how the account has performed and can pay.
Done when the loss and financial sections are recorded on the analysis tab.
verify: Compare the stated loss ratio against the loss exhibit figure.
Pass when the narrative figures match the source exhibits.

steps.title: State the risk quality score and its drivers
sop: Compute or retrieve the risk quality score for the account.
List the attributes that pushed the score up and those that pulled it down.
Enter the score in the account scoring field and repeat it in the narrative.
Done when the score and its named drivers appear in both places.
verify: Compare the narrative score against the account scoring field value.
Pass when the two values are identical.

steps.title: Name the appetite class and cite the guideline paragraph
sop: Match the account class and hazard profile to the documented appetite statement.
Name the appetite class the account falls in.
Cite the guideline paragraph relied on by number and version.
Done when the appetite class and guideline citation are recorded in the narrative.
verify: Open the cited guideline paragraph and read it against the account facts.
Pass when the citation supports the appetite class stated.

steps.title: List residual concerns carried into terms
sop: List each concern that will not be resolved before binding.
Name the subjectivity, exclusion or deductible level that addresses each concern.
Flag any concern with no proposed treatment for referral.
Done when every residual concern has a named treatment or a referral flag.
verify: Check each listed concern against the draft terms.
Pass when no residual concern lacks a treatment or a flag.

steps.title: Lock the narrative on the underwriting analysis tab
sop: Re-read the narrative for completeness against the five required sections.
Submit the narrative for lock in the underwriting workstation.
Confirm the system captured the author name and timestamp on lock.
Done when the narrative shows as locked with author and timestamp.
verify: Attempt to edit the locked narrative and confirm an audit entry is required.
Pass when the narrative is locked and stamped.

steps.title: Review the locked narrative before terms are issued
sop: Read the narrative against the exposure, hazard, loss and financial records on the account.
Challenge any conclusion not supported by a recorded input.
Record the review outcome on the account analysis tab.
Done when the review outcome is recorded against the locked narrative.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the narrative carries a recorded review outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: The accept, decline or refer decision taken on this single risk
generic.In-scope period: From decision point until the rationale note is locked on the risk file
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision, authority level, decisive factors and guideline reference all recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Decision recorded in the rationale matches the decision status on the policy record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale note attached to the risk file with author, timestamp and audit protection
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every deviation from guideline recorded with the approver name and approval date
generic.Test population: All risks reaching an accept, decline or refer decision in the period under audit
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the note omits the guideline applied or the deciding authority level
generic.Exception handling path: Decisions above the recorded authority routed to the Underwriting Director for approval and note
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rationale entry naming the guideline applied and the deciding authority on the risk file
generic.Evidence location: Risk file rationale note in the underwriting workstation and the policy administration system

steps.title: Record the decision and authority level on the risk file
sop: Open the risk file rationale note in the underwriting workstation.
Select accept, decline or refer as the decision taken.
Record the authority level under which the decision was taken from the authority matrix.
Done when the decision and its authority level are saved on the note.
verify: Compare the recorded authority level against the authority matrix entry for the underwriter.
Pass when the decision sits inside the recorded authority or a referral exists.

steps.title: Record the decisive risk factors behind the decision
sop: Identify the two or three factors that actually carried the decision.
State each factor with the evidence record it came from.
Avoid restating the full analysis and keep the note to the decisive points.
Done when at least two decisive factors are recorded with their evidence source.
verify: Trace each stated factor to a record on the account.
Pass when every factor cited exists in the account evidence.

steps.title: Cite the guideline or referral trigger applied by name
sop: Identify the guideline, appetite statement or referral trigger that governed the decision.
Record it by name and version in the rationale note.
Where a referral trigger fired, state which trigger and what it required.
Done when a named guideline or trigger reference is present in the note.
verify: Open the cited guideline version and confirm it was in force at the decision date.
Pass when the cited version was in force on that date.

steps.title: Record any deviation from guideline with its approver
sop: Compare the terms decided against the guideline standard terms.
List each deviation in limits, deductibles, exclusions or price.
Record the approver name and approval date against each deviation.
Done when every deviation carries a named approver and date.
verify: Cross-check each approver against the authority matrix for that deviation type.
Pass when no deviation is approved below the required authority.

steps.title: Attach the rationale note to the risk file under audit protection
sop: Submit the completed note to the risk file record.
Confirm the system stamps author and timestamp on submission.
Confirm subsequent edits require an audit entry rather than silent overwrite.
Done when the note is attached and shows as audit protected.
verify: Open the note history and check the author and timestamp entries.
Pass when the note is attached with an intact audit history.

steps.title: Confirm the recorded decision matches the policy administration system status
sop: Open the risk record in the policy administration system.
Compare the decision status there against the decision in the rationale note.
Correct either record where they disagree and note the correction.
Done when both systems show the same decision status.
verify: Re-read both records after any correction.
Pass when the two decision statuses agree.

steps.title: Review the rationale note on referred and deviated risks
sop: Open rationale notes for risks that were referred or carried a deviation.
Check the guideline citation, decisive factors and approver record are all present.
Return incomplete notes to the underwriter for completion before terms release.
Done when each reviewed note is marked accepted or returned.
verify: Confirm the review marking is present on each referred or deviated risk.
Pass when no such risk is left without a review marking.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims on the account loss history split between attritional and large layers
generic.In-scope period: The five prior policy years trended to a common cost level for benchmark comparison
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim counts, average severity, exposure units and benchmark values held per year
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts used in the benchmark plots tie to the loss run counts by year
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark comparison saved to the account with the benchmark source and edition cited
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Years excluded from the comparison logged with the reason for exclusion
generic.Test population: Every policy year with credible claim volume for the account class code
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the benchmark source is not cited or the large-loss split is not shown
generic.Exception handling path: Classes without a published benchmark referred to the Pricing Actuary for a proxy selection
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Frequency and severity comparison against benchmark with the source cited on the account
generic.Evidence location: Benchmark comparison exhibit on the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Select the class benchmark and record its source in the exhibit
sop: Identify the class code and segment the account is being benchmarked against.
Select the published frequency and severity benchmark for that class.
Record the benchmark source, edition and cost level on the exhibit.
Done when the benchmark source and edition are recorded on the exhibit.
verify: Check the benchmark class code matches the account class code.
Pass when the benchmark class and the account class agree.

steps.title: Plot claim frequency per exposure unit against the benchmark in Power BI
sop: Load the per-year frequency series from the Excel loss exhibit into Power BI.
Overlay the class benchmark frequency line on the same axis.
Confirm both series use the same exposure unit definition.
Done when the frequency plot shows the account and benchmark series together.
verify: Compare the exposure unit label on both series.
Pass when both series share the same exposure unit.

steps.title: Plot average incurred severity against the benchmark at a common cost level
sop: Compute average incurred severity per year from the loss exhibit.
Trend each year severity to the benchmark cost level and state the trend rate used.
Overlay the benchmark severity line on the plotted account series.
Done when the severity plot shows both series trended to a common cost level.
verify: Check the cost level stated on the account series matches the benchmark cost level.
Pass when both series sit at the same cost level.

steps.title: Split attritional from large losses at the large-loss threshold
sop: Apply the current large-loss threshold for the line to every claim.
Compute frequency and severity separately for the attritional and large layers.
Comment on how each layer behaves relative to the benchmark.
Done when both layers carry their own frequency and severity read.
verify: Sum the attritional and large layer claim counts against the total count.
Pass when the two layers reconcile to the total claim count.

steps.title: Identify repeat cause-of-loss patterns in the claim data
sop: Group claims by cause of loss in the Excel exhibit.
Identify causes contributing disproportionate frequency such as slips, water damage or rear-end collisions.
Record the top causes with their share of total claim count.
Done when the leading cause-of-loss drivers are recorded with their share.
verify: Sum the recorded cause shares against one hundred percent of claims.
Pass when the cause grouping accounts for the full claim count.

steps.title: Record the better or worse than benchmark conclusion on the account
sop: Compute the percentage the account runs above or below benchmark on frequency.
Compute the same percentage on severity.
Record both percentages and the overall conclusion on the account analysis record.
Done when both percentages and the conclusion are recorded on the account.
verify: Recompute one percentage from the plotted account and benchmark values.
Pass when the recomputed percentage matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Review the benchmark evaluation before it informs pricing
sop: Read the exhibit for benchmark source, layer split and stated conclusion.
Challenge conclusions drawn from years with low claim credibility.
Record the review outcome against the exhibit on the account.
Done when the review outcome is recorded on the exhibit.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and date.
Pass when the exhibit carries a recorded review outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every coverage part, sublimit and deductible proposed for this account
generic.In-scope period: The prospective policy term with the five-year loss history used as the test data
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requested limit, modelled PML, each sublimit and the BI indemnity period all recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sublimits reviewed equal the sublimits listed on the proposed terms schedule
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Gap findings saved on the account with the PML model run date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each identified gap logged with increase, endorse, raise deductible or decline recommended
generic.Test population: All coverage parts on the submission including any requested by endorsement
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any sublimit is left untested or any gap lacks a recommended remedy
generic.Exception handling path: Limits below modelled PML referred to the Senior Underwriter before terms are released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Findings list every sublimit and deductible gap with a recommended remedy
generic.Evidence location: Coverage adequacy findings on the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Compare requested limits against the modelled PML on the account
sop: Retrieve the modelled PML or largest foreseeable loss for the account.
Compare it against the limit requested for each affected coverage part.
Record any shortfall as an amount and as a percentage of PML.
Done when every requested limit carries a PML comparison result.
verify: Check the PML figure used carries a model run date inside the guideline window.
Pass when the comparison uses a current PML figure.

steps.title: Test each sublimit against the exposure it protects
sop: List every sublimit on the proposed terms including flood, quake, BI, EDP and off-premises power.
For each, identify the exposure value it is intended to cover.
Record adequate or inadequate against each sublimit with the exposure figure used.
Done when every listed sublimit carries an adequacy result.
verify: Compare the tested sublimit count against the terms schedule sublimit count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Check the business interruption indemnity period against rebuild time
sop: Read the stated rebuild or recovery time from the survey or the insured submission.
Compare it against the BI indemnity period requested.
Record whether the indemnity period covers the stated recovery time.
Done when the indemnity period adequacy result is recorded on the account.
verify: Check the recovery time cited traces to a survey or submission document.
Pass when the recovery time used has a documented source.

steps.title: Assess the deductible level against sub-deductible loss frequency
sop: Count claims in the five-year history falling below the proposed deductible.
Compute the loss value retained by the insured at that deductible.
Record whether the deductible is appropriate for the observed frequency.
Done when the deductible assessment and the retained loss figure are recorded.
verify: Recount sub-deductible claims from the loss history.
Pass when the recount matches the recorded count.

steps.title: List every identified gap with a recommended remedy
sop: Collect every inadequate limit, sublimit and deductible result into a single findings list.
Against each, recommend increase limit, add endorsement, raise deductible or decline the exposure.
Record the reason each remedy was selected.
Done when every gap on the list carries a named remedy and reason.
verify: Check each inadequate result appears on the findings list.
Pass when no inadequate result is missing from the list.

steps.title: Record the findings on the account and flow them into proposed terms
sop: Save the findings list to the account coverage adequacy record.
Update the proposed terms in the policy administration system to reflect accepted remedies.
Record any remedy the broker rejects with the resulting exposure accepted.
Done when accepted remedies appear on the proposed terms and rejections are recorded.
verify: Compare the proposed terms against the accepted remedies list.
Pass when every accepted remedy is reflected in the terms.

steps.title: Review coverage adequacy findings before terms release
sop: Read the findings list against the PML, sublimit and deductible records.
Challenge any limit left below modelled PML without a stated acceptance.
Record the review outcome on the account adequacy record.
Done when the review outcome is recorded against the findings.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the findings carry a recorded review outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: All incumbent carriers on the risk plus the third-party data sets the class requires
generic.In-scope period: Five prior policy years of loss runs valued within ninety days of the effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor, order date, expected turnaround and valuation date held for every order
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Orders logged equal the number of carrier years plus data sets required
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Order confirmations and returned files saved to the account with receipt dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Orders past SLA logged with each chase date and the outcome recorded
generic.Test population: Every submission requiring external loss and risk data before underwriting analysis
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if fewer than five carrier years are ordered or any valuation exceeds ninety days
generic.Exception handling path: Unavailable carrier years escalated to the Underwriter for a broker attestation decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Order log showing five years of loss runs and external data requested with valuation dates
generic.Evidence location: Outstanding order tracker on the submission in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Identify incumbent carriers and required data sets from the submission
sop: Read the submission for the incumbent carrier on each of the five prior policy years.
Identify the third-party data sets the class requires such as MVRs or property characteristics.
List each carrier year and data set as a separate order line.
Done when every required order line is listed on the tracker.
verify: Count carrier year lines against five policy years.
Pass when five carrier years are listed or a gap reason is recorded.

steps.title: Order currently valued loss runs from each incumbent carrier
sop: Send a loss run request to each incumbent carrier naming the policy number and period.
Request a valuation date no earlier than ninety days before the effective date.
Record the request date and expected turnaround on each tracker line.
Done when every carrier year line shows a sent request with a recorded date.
verify: Check each tracker line carries a request date.
Pass when no carrier year line is left unrequested.

steps.title: Order the third-party risk data set through LexisNexis Risk
sop: Open LexisNexis Risk and select the data products the class requires.
Submit the order using the insured identifiers taken from the submission.
Record the vendor order reference and expected return date on the tracker.
Done when each third-party data order carries a logged reference.
verify: Compare ordered data products against the class requirement list.
Pass when every required data product has been ordered.

steps.title: Check valuation dates on returned loss runs and re-order stale ones
sop: On receipt, read the valuation date printed on each loss run.
Compare it against the ninety-day currency rule measured to the effective date.
Re-order any run valued outside that window and log the re-order.
Done when every received run is inside the currency window or re-ordered.
verify: List received runs with valuation dates outside the window.
Pass when that list is empty or every entry shows a re-order.

steps.title: Chase orders past their turnaround SLA and diary each chase
sop: Run the tracker filtered to orders past their expected return date.
Contact the carrier or vendor for each and record the chase in the submission diary.
Set the next chase date on each open line.
Done when every overdue order carries a logged chase and a next chase date.
verify: Filter for overdue orders with no chase logged.
Pass when that filter returns zero lines.

steps.title: Confirm data receipt and close the order tracker for the submission
sop: Review the tracker for outstanding lines and their age in days.
Decide the treatment for any year that cannot be obtained and record it.
Mark the external data requirement satisfied on the submission.
Done when all order lines are received or dispositioned and the requirement is marked satisfied.
verify: Count open tracker lines with no disposition.
Pass when that count is zero.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims on the five-year loss runs held for the account across every incumbent carrier
generic.In-scope period: Five complete policy years ending at the most recent valuation date on file
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Carrier, policy number, valuation date and paid versus reserve split present on every run
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts and incurred totals reconcile to the broker loss summary within five percent
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loss runs attached to the account with carrier name and valuation date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing years and reconciliation differences over five percent logged with the query outcome
generic.Test population: Every policy year in the five-year window including years with nil claims
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a missing year has no recorded reason or a large loss is unread
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled differences queried with the broker and escalated to the Senior Underwriter if unresolved
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Five-year history reviewed with large losses annotated and totals reconciled to the broker summary
generic.Evidence location: Loss history review record on the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Confirm five complete policy years are on file in the workstation
sop: List the loss runs attached to the account by policy year.
Identify any year in the five-year window with no run on file.
Record the reason for each missing year such as first-year operations or carrier refusal.
Done when every year in the window is present or carries a documented reason.
verify: Count years present plus years with a reason against five.
Pass when the two together cover the full five-year window.

steps.title: Check header integrity on every loss run
sop: Read carrier name, policy number and valuation date from each run header.
Confirm the paid and reserve amounts are shown separately rather than only as incurred.
Request a replacement run where any header field or the split is absent.
Done when every run on file carries all four header elements.
verify: Filter runs for a missing header element.
Pass when the filter returns zero runs.

steps.title: Read every claim above the large-loss threshold
sop: Filter the combined claim list to claims above the large-loss threshold for the line.
Read the narrative for cause, current status and reserve basis on each.
Annotate each large loss on the account with cause and status.
Done when every large loss carries a recorded cause and status annotation.
verify: Count annotated large losses against the filtered large-loss count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Assess open claims for reserve development potential
sop: Filter the claim list to claims still open at the valuation date.
Assess each for likely deterioration using reserve level, age and injury or damage type.
Flag claims likely to develop and record the expected direction.
Done when every open claim carries a development assessment.
verify: Compare flagged claims against the open claim count.
Pass when every open claim has been assessed.

steps.title: Reconcile counts and incurred totals to the broker summary in Excel
sop: Total claim counts and incurred amounts by year in Microsoft Excel.
Compare each year against the broker loss summary figures.
Record every difference above five percent as a query line.
Done when each year shows a reconciliation result and queries are recorded.
verify: Recompute one year total from the underlying loss run.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the reconciliation sheet.

steps.title: Clear reconciliation queries with the broker and record the outcome
sop: Send each query line above five percent to the broker with the two figures shown.
Record the broker explanation and whether the loss data is amended.
Update the reconciliation sheet with the accepted figures.
Done when no query line above five percent remains open.
verify: Filter query lines for an open status.
Pass when that filter returns zero lines.

steps.title: Review the completed loss history read before analysis proceeds
sop: Read the large-loss annotations, open claim flags and reconciliation results.
Challenge any reliance on a year with an unexplained missing run.
Record the review outcome on the loss history review record.
Done when the review outcome is recorded on the account.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the review record carries a reviewer and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every impairment and abnormal finding surfaced by the evidence gathered on this life case
generic.In-scope period: All evidence received up to the point the case note is written
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Impairment, control status, duration, debit or credit points and manual page recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Debit and credit points listed in the note sum to the total stated on the case
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Case note saved with author, timestamp and the manual version referenced
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Outstanding requirements that could change classification listed with their expected return date
generic.Test population: Every life case where medical evidence has been received and evaluated
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any abnormal lab value or impairment is unmentioned in the note
generic.Exception handling path: Findings outside the underwriter authority referred to the Senior Underwriter before the note closes
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case note listing impairments, debits and credits and the indicated risk class
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting case notes on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List every impairment found across the case evidence
sop: Read the application, APS, exam and lab results held on the case.
List each impairment with its build, control status and duration since diagnosis.
Mark any impairment that appears in only one evidence source for corroboration.
Done when every impairment found is listed with build, control and duration.
verify: Cross-check the impairment list against the APS diagnosis list.
Pass when no APS diagnosis is missing from the note.

steps.title: Record debit and credit points with the manual page reference
sop: For each impairment, look up the manual page giving its debit or credit.
Record the point value and the manual page reference in the case note.
Sum the points and state the net total.
Done when every impairment carries a point value and a manual reference.
verify: Re-add the listed point values and compare against the stated net total.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the stated total.

steps.title: Note lab values outside reference range and their underwriting effect
sop: Read the lab panel for values outside the reference range such as HbA1c, cotinine, LFTs or NT-proBNP.
Record each out-of-range value with its result and reference band.
State the underwriting effect of each abnormal result on the case.
Done when every out-of-range value is recorded with its underwriting effect.
verify: Compare the recorded abnormal values against the flagged results on the lab report.
Pass when every flagged lab result appears in the note.

steps.title: State the preliminary risk class indicated by the evidence
sop: Convert the net point total into the indicated class or table rating.
State the preliminary class before any reinsurer consultation.
Record the assumptions that would change the class if they proved wrong.
Done when a preliminary class is stated with its point basis.
verify: Check the stated class against the point total conversion table.
Pass when the class follows from the recorded points.

steps.title: List outstanding requirements that could change the classification
sop: Read the requirements tracker for items still open on the case.
List those capable of changing the class such as a pending APS or re-test.
State for each what change it could produce.
Done when every classification-relevant open requirement is listed with its potential effect.
verify: Compare the listed items against open lines on the requirements tracker.
Pass when no open classification-relevant requirement is omitted.

steps.title: Save the case note to the case record and the policy administration system
sop: Save the completed note to the underwriting case notes in the workstation.
Confirm the note is visible against the case in the policy administration system.
Confirm author and timestamp are captured on save.
Done when the note is saved in both systems with author and timestamp.
verify: Open the case in the policy administration system and locate the note.
Pass when the same note is retrievable from both systems.

steps.title: Review the evidence evaluation note before decision
sop: Read the note against the APS, lab and application evidence on the case.
Challenge any impairment omitted or any point value without a manual reference.
Record the review outcome on the case note record.
Done when the review outcome is recorded against the note.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the note carries a recorded review outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: All medical evidence held on the case measured against the underwriting manual in force
generic.In-scope period: Evidence covering the manual lookback period up to the evaluation date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Manual version, build debit, each impairment table rating and tobacco class recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Impairments evaluated equal the impairments listed on the evidence summary
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Evaluation saved on the case with the manual version and evaluation date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Findings outside the manual tables logged and referred with the referral outcome recorded
generic.Test population: Every life case where full medical evidence has been received
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any genetic test result influenced a rating or the manual version is unrecorded
generic.Exception handling path: Impairments without a manual table referred to the Pricing Actuary for a rating basis
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Evaluation recording build, impairment tables and tobacco class verification against the manual
generic.Evidence location: Medical evaluation record on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Record the underwriting manual version in force on the case
sop: Identify the underwriting manual version effective at the evaluation date.
Record the version and its effective date on the case evaluation record.
Confirm no superseded manual edition is being used.
Done when the manual version and effective date are recorded on the case.
verify: Compare the recorded version against the current published manual version.
Pass when the recorded version is the one in force at the evaluation date.

steps.title: Assess build against the height and weight table
sop: Read the measured height and weight from the paramedical exam result.
Locate the corresponding cell in the manual build table.
Record the build debit or credit produced by that cell.
Done when the build result and its table cell are recorded on the case.
verify: Re-look up the build cell using the exam height and weight.
Pass when the recorded debit matches the table cell.

steps.title: Apply the impairment rating table for each disclosed condition
sop: List each disclosed or discovered condition from the evidence summary.
Apply the manual impairment table matching the condition and its control status.
Record the table rating produced against each condition.
Done when every condition carries a table rating and its manual section.
verify: Compare the rated condition count against the evidence summary condition count.
Pass when every condition on the summary has been rated.

steps.title: Cross-check nicotine and drug screen results against the declared tobacco class
sop: Read the cotinine and drug screen results from the lab report.
Compare them against the tobacco use declared on the application.
Record any conflict and the tobacco class the evidence supports.
Done when the tobacco class is recorded and any conflict is noted.
verify: Check the recorded tobacco class against the cotinine result.
Pass when the class is consistent with the lab evidence.

steps.title: Confirm no genetic test result has been used as a rating factor
sop: Scan the APS and lab evidence for any genetic test result present on the case.
Confirm no debit, credit or table rating on the evaluation traces to such a result.
Record the exclusion statement on the evaluation record.
Done when the evaluation carries an explicit genetic exclusion statement.
verify: Trace each recorded debit to a non-genetic evidence source.
Pass when no rating factor traces to a genetic test result.

steps.title: Consult the Pricing Actuary on impairments with no manual table
sop: Receive the list of impairments with no manual table entry.
Provide a rating basis drawn from the actuarial risk classification tables.
Record the basis supplied and its source on the case.
Done when every table-less impairment carries a supplied rating basis.
verify: Compare referred impairments against those with a supplied basis.
Pass when every referred impairment has a recorded basis.

steps.title: Complete and review the medical evaluation record
sop: Read the evaluation for manual version, build, impairment tables and tobacco class.
Challenge any rating not traceable to a manual section or actuarial basis.
Record the review outcome on the evaluation record.
Done when the review outcome is recorded against the evaluation.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the evaluation carries a recorded review outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every MIB code returned and every medication listed on the RxDB report for this case
generic.In-scope period: The full MIB and RxDB lookback period available for the applicant
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Code, decoded impairment, report date and disclosure match status held for each entry
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Codes and medications assessed equal the counts returned on the vendor reports
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: MIB and RxDB reports attached to the case with return dates recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every undisclosed condition flagged with the follow-up action recorded against it
generic.Test population: All life cases where MIB and RxDB results have been returned
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any returned code or medication is left without an assessment
generic.Exception handling path: Codes implying undisclosed impairment routed to an APS order or applicant re-interview
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment recorded with each finding reconciled to the application disclosures
generic.Evidence location: MIB and RxDB assessment on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Decode each returned MIB code on the case record
sop: Open the returned MIB report attached to the case in the underwriting workstation.
Decode each code into the impairment it signals using the current code list.
Record the decoded impairment and the reporting date beside each code.
Done when every returned code carries a decoded impairment and report date.
verify: Count decoded entries against the codes returned on the report.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Compare each MIB code against the application disclosures
sop: Read the application health disclosures for the applicant.
Match each decoded impairment against a disclosed condition.
Flag every code with no matching disclosure as undisclosed.
Done when each code is marked disclosed or undisclosed.
verify: Filter codes with no disclosure status.
Pass when the filter returns zero codes.

steps.title: Map each RxDB medication to its treated condition and dosage trend
sop: Read the RxDB report retrieved via LexisNexis Risk for the applicant.
Map each medication to the condition it treats and record the dosage over time.
Note whether dosage is rising, stable or discontinued.
Done when every medication carries a condition mapping and dosage trend.
verify: Count mapped medications against the RxDB report line count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Flag medications implying an undisclosed impairment
sop: Review medications indicating serious conditions such as anticoagulants, insulin or antiretrovirals.
Compare each against the disclosed condition list on the application.
Flag every medication implying a condition the applicant did not disclose.
Done when each implying medication is flagged with the implied condition named.
verify: Check each flagged medication has an implied condition recorded.
Pass when no flag is left without an implied condition.

steps.title: Decide whether the findings trigger an APS order or re-interview
sop: Assess the undisclosed codes and flagged medications for underwriting materiality.
Decide for each whether an APS order or an applicant re-interview is required.
Raise the requirement on the tracker for every item requiring follow-up.
Done when every material finding carries a raised follow-up requirement.
verify: Compare material findings against raised requirements on the tracker.
Pass when every material finding has a matching requirement.

steps.title: Record the MIB and RxDB assessment conclusion on the case
sop: Summarise the codes decoded, disclosure conflicts and medication findings.
State the effect on the preliminary classification.
Save the assessment to the case with the report dates cited.
Done when the assessment conclusion is saved on the case record.
verify: Check the assessment cites the MIB and RxDB report return dates.
Pass when both report dates appear in the saved assessment.

generic.Defined scope/population: The financial evidence set required for this case by the age and amount grid
generic.In-scope period: Two most recent tax years for income plus current-dated net worth documentation
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor, request date, expected return date and document type held for every order
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Orders logged equal the evidence items the grid requires for the face amount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed applicant authorisation attached to the case with its signature date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items the applicant cannot supply logged with the alternative evidence accepted
generic.Test population: Every case whose face amount crosses the financial evidence threshold
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any order was placed without a current signed authorisation on file
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or refused financial documents referred to the Life Underwriter for an amount decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Financial evidence orders logged with signed applicant authorisation attached to the case
generic.Evidence location: Requirements tracker on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Confirm the face amount crosses the financial evidence threshold
sop: Read the issue age and face amount from the application in the workstation.
Locate the matching cell in the age and amount grid.
Record whether financial evidence is required and which tier applies.
Done when the grid cell and required tier are recorded on the case.
verify: Re-look up the grid cell using the recorded age and face amount.
Pass when the recorded tier matches the grid cell.

steps.title: Confirm the signed applicant authorisation is current
sop: Open the authorisation attached to the case and read its signature date.
Confirm it is inside its validity window and covers financial evidence release.
Request a fresh authorisation where it is expired or scope-limited.
Done when a current authorisation covering financial evidence is on the case.
verify: Check the authorisation signature date against the validity window.
Pass when the authorisation is unexpired and in scope.

steps.title: Order the confirmatory financial questionnaire for the case type
sop: Select the personal or business financial questionnaire matching the case type.
Send it to the producer with the return deadline stated.
Log the request date and expected return on the requirements tracker.
Done when the questionnaire request is logged with a return date.
verify: Check the questionnaire type against the case ownership structure.
Pass when the questionnaire matches the case type.

steps.title: Order income verification documents
sop: Request two years of tax returns and W-2 forms from the applicant through the producer.
Where self-employed, request an accountant letter confirming earned income instead.
Log each requested document with its request date on the tracker.
Done when income verification items are requested and logged.
verify: Count logged income items against the tier requirement.
Pass when every required income item is logged.

steps.title: Order net worth documentation
sop: Request the personal financial statement for individually owned cases.
Request the business balance sheet where the case is business owned.
Log each request with vendor or source and expected return date.
Done when net worth documentation is requested and logged.
verify: Check the document type requested against the ownership recorded on the case.
Pass when the request matches the ownership structure.

steps.title: Sync the orders to the policy administration system requirements
sop: Open the case requirements in the policy administration system.
Add each financial evidence order as an open requirement with its due date.
Confirm the workstation tracker and the policy system show the same open items.
Done when both systems list the same financial evidence requirements.
verify: Compare the open item counts in both systems.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm the ordered evidence set is sufficient for the amount applied for
sop: Read the ordered evidence list against the financial underwriting guideline for the amount.
Order any additional item the guideline requires for the case type.
Record the confirmation that the evidence set is complete.
Done when the evidence set is confirmed sufficient or supplemented.
verify: Compare the ordered set against the guideline requirement list.
Pass when no guideline-required item is unordered.

generic.Defined scope/population: The proposed insured on this life case for whom MIB and RxDB checks are required
generic.In-scope period: The full RxDB lookback available and the MIB reporting history for the applicant
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Applicant name, date of birth, residence and both order references recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Two order references exist on the tracker matching the two reports required
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed authorisation attached with signature date and validity window recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vendor rejections or no-hit returns logged with the action taken recorded
generic.Test population: Every life case requiring MIB and RxDB under the selected underwriting path
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if either order was placed with an expired or missing authorisation
generic.Exception handling path: Identity mismatches returned by the vendor escalated to the Life Underwriter before re-order
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: MIB inquiry and RxDB order references recorded with a current signed authorisation on file
generic.Evidence location: Requirements tracker on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Verify the applicant authorisation is signed and unexpired
sop: Open the authorisation document attached to the case in the underwriting workstation.
Confirm it is signed, dated and inside its validity window of normally twenty-four months.
Request a replacement authorisation where it is unsigned or expired.
Done when a signed and unexpired authorisation is confirmed on the case.
verify: Compare the authorisation signature date against the validity window rule.
Pass when the authorisation is current at the order date.

steps.title: Submit the MIB inquiry with the application identity details
sop: Read the exact name, date of birth and residence from the application.
Submit the MIB inquiry using those details without abbreviation or correction.
Capture the MIB inquiry reference returned on submission.
Done when the MIB inquiry is submitted and its reference captured.
verify: Compare the submitted identity fields against the application record.
Pass when all three identity fields match the application exactly.

steps.title: Order the RxDB prescription history for the full lookback
sop: Open the RxDB order screen and select the maximum available lookback period.
Submit the order using the same identity details used for the MIB inquiry.
Capture the RxDB order reference and the lookback period ordered.
Done when the RxDB order is placed with its reference and lookback recorded.
verify: Check the lookback ordered against the maximum available period.
Pass when the full available lookback was requested.

steps.title: Record both order references on the requirements tracker
sop: Open the requirements tracker on the case in the underwriting workstation.
Add an open requirement line for the MIB inquiry and one for the RxDB order.
Record the reference, order date and expected return on each line.
Done when both requirement lines exist with references and dates.
verify: Count open MIB and RxDB lines on the tracker.
Pass when both lines exist with a reference recorded.

steps.title: Mirror the open requirements into the policy administration system
sop: Open the case requirements view in the policy administration system.
Add the MIB and RxDB requirements with the same due dates used on the tracker.
Confirm the two systems show the same open requirement set.
Done when both systems list the MIB and RxDB requirements as open.
verify: Compare the requirement lists in both systems.
Pass when the two lists agree.

steps.title: Diary the vendor turnaround and chase unreturned orders
sop: Set a follow-up diary for the normal twenty-four to forty-eight hour turnaround.
Chase the vendor where either report has not returned by the diary date.
Log each chase with the date and vendor response on the tracker line.
Done when both reports are returned or each carries a logged chase.
verify: Filter overdue MIB or RxDB lines for a missing chase entry.
Pass when that filter returns zero lines.

steps.title: Confirm returned reports are for the correct applicant
sop: Read the identity block on each returned report.
Compare name, date of birth and residence against the application record.
Re-order where any identity element does not match and log the mismatch.
Done when both reports are confirmed as belonging to the proposed insured.
verify: Check each report identity block against the application.
Pass when both reports match the applicant identity.

generic.Defined scope/population: The proposed insured driving record where an MVR trigger applies to this case
generic.In-scope period: The guideline lookback of normally three to five years of driving history
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Licence number, state of issue, date of birth, lookback period and trigger recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Major and minor violation counts recorded match the violations listed on the MVR
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: MVR attached to the case with the order date and lookback period recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched or unavailable licence records logged with the alternative action taken
generic.Test population: Every case where a driving, aviation, avocation or violation trigger is present
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the MVR was ordered without a recorded trigger or lookback period
generic.Exception handling path: MVRs showing major violations referred to the Life Underwriter for a debit or referral decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: MVR order recorded with the triggering factor and lookback period stated on the case
generic.Evidence location: Requirements tracker and attached MVR on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Confirm an MVR trigger applies to the case
sop: Read the application for driving occupation, aviation activity or hazardous avocation.
Read the disclosures for any moving violation declared by the applicant.
Record which trigger applies or record that no trigger is present.
Done when the applicable trigger or its absence is recorded on the case.
verify: Compare the recorded trigger against the guideline trigger list.
Pass when the recorded trigger appears on that list.

steps.title: Order the MVR through LexisNexis Risk with licence details
sop: Read the licence number, state of issue and date of birth from the application.
Submit the MVR order in LexisNexis Risk using those details.
Capture the order reference and submission date.
Done when the MVR order is submitted and its reference captured.
verify: Compare the submitted licence details against the application record.
Pass when all licence details match the application.

steps.title: Set the lookback period to the guideline range and record it
sop: Select the lookback period required by guideline of normally three to five years.
Confirm the state permits the requested lookback and adjust where it does not.
Record the lookback period ordered on the requirements tracker.
Done when the ordered lookback period is recorded on the tracker.
verify: Compare the recorded lookback against the guideline period for the case.
Pass when the ordered period meets or exceeds the guideline minimum.

steps.title: Count major and minor violations on the returned MVR
sop: Read the returned MVR attached to the case in the underwriting workstation.
Count major violations covering DUI, reckless driving and licence suspension.
Count minor violations separately and record both counts.
Done when both violation counts are recorded on the case.
verify: Recount violations from the MVR listing.
Pass when the recount matches the recorded counts.

steps.title: Record the MVR score band and resulting debit or referral
sop: Map the violation counts to the MVR score band in the underwriting manual.
Record the band and the debit it produces on the requirements tracker.
Raise a referral where the band exceeds the acceptance guideline.
Done when the score band and its debit or referral are recorded.
verify: Re-map the recorded counts to the manual score band.
Pass when the recorded band follows from the violation counts.

steps.title: Close the MVR requirement on the tracker
sop: Attach the returned MVR to the case record in the underwriting workstation.
Mark the MVR requirement satisfied with the receipt date.
Record any unavailable record with the reason supplied by the vendor.
Done when the MVR requirement is closed or carries a recorded unavailability reason.
verify: Check the tracker line status against the attached MVR.
Pass when the requirement status matches the evidence on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The paramedical exam and laboratory panel required for this case by the age and amount grid

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ordered panel components equal the components the grid tier prescribes

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the ordered panel does not match the grid tier for age and face amount
generic.Exception handling path: Applicants refusing the exam referred to the Life Underwriter for a path or amount change
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Paramed and lab orders logged matching the age and amount grid tier for the case
generic.Evidence location: Requirements tracker on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Read the age and amount grid and record the required exam tier

Locate the matching cell in the age and amount grid.
Record the exam tier and the components that cell requires.
Done when the grid cell and exam tier are recorded on the case.
verify: Re-look up the grid cell from the recorded age and amount.
Pass when the recorded tier matches the grid cell.

steps.title: Instruct the paramedical vendor with applicant contact details
