State the preferred appointment window supplied by the producer.
Capture the vendor order reference and expected booking date.
Done when the paramed order is placed with a captured vendor reference.
verify: Compare the contact details sent against the application record.
Pass when the contact details match the application.

steps.title: Order the laboratory panel matching the grid tier
sop: Order the blood profile, urinalysis and cotinine components for the tier.
Add HbA1c or NT-proBNP where the grid cell calls for them.
Record each ordered component on the requirements tracker.
Done when every component the tier requires is ordered and logged.
verify: Compare ordered components against the tier component list.
Pass when no tier component is unordered.

steps.title: Order EKG, treadmill or APS add-ons required by the grid cell
sop: Read the grid cell for add-on requirements beyond the standard panel.
Order each add-on with the vendor and record its reference.
Note where an add-on is not required so the omission is deliberate.
Done when every add-on is ordered or recorded as not required.
verify: Compare ordered add-ons against the grid cell add-on list.
Pass when the two lists agree.

steps.title: Diary the exam completion and chase unbooked appointments
sop: Set a diary for booking confirmation within five business days of the order.
Chase the vendor where no appointment is booked by that date.
Log each chase and notify the producer where applicant action is needed.
Done when the exam is booked or a chase and producer notification are logged.
verify: Filter orders past five days without a booking or a chase entry.
Pass when that filter returns zero orders.

steps.title: Mirror the exam and lab requirements into the policy administration system
sop: Open the case requirements view in the policy administration system.
Add the paramed exam and each lab component as open requirements.
Confirm both systems show the same open exam and lab items.
Done when the requirement sets in both systems agree.
verify: Compare open item counts in the workstation and the policy system.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm the ordered evidence matches the case path
sop: Read the ordered exam and lab set against the triage-selected underwriting path.
Order any missing component or cancel any not required by the path.
Record the confirmation on the case requirements record.
Done when the ordered set is confirmed correct for the path.
verify: Compare the ordered set against the path evidence requirement list.
Pass when the ordered set matches the path requirement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every treating physician named on the application or implied by the RxDB findings
generic.In-scope period: The records date range set by guideline lookback for each physician requested
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Physician name, address, request date, date range and receipt status held per request
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: APS requests raised equal the treating physicians identified on the case
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Received APS records indexed to the case with receipt date and page count
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Truncated or mismatched records logged with the re-request recorded against them
generic.Test population: All life cases where an APS or prescription history is required
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any APS was requested without the signed authorisation attached
generic.Exception handling path: Non-responding physicians escalated to the Life Underwriter for an alternative evidence decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: APS and prescription history loaded to the case with authorisation evidence attached
generic.Evidence location: Case evidence index in the underwriting workstation and the policy administration system

steps.title: Identify every treating physician for the case
sop: Read the application for named physicians and treatment history.
Read the RxDB findings for prescribers implying a treating relationship.
List each physician with address and the condition they treat.
Done when the physician list is complete with addresses recorded.
verify: Compare the physician list against the RxDB prescriber list.
Pass when no prescriber implying treatment is omitted.

steps.title: Send APS requests with the signed authorisation attached
sop: Attach the signed authorisation to each APS request package.
State the records date range required for each physician.
Send each request and log the send date on the requirements tracker.
Done when every listed physician has a logged APS request with authorisation attached.
verify: Count requests sent against the physician list count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Request the prescription history for the guideline lookback
sop: Determine the guideline lookback period for prescription history on this case.
Request the history covering at least that period.
Log the request with its date range on the requirements tracker.
Done when the prescription history request is logged with its date range.
verify: Compare the requested range against the guideline lookback.
Pass when the requested range meets or exceeds the guideline.

steps.title: Check received records against applicant identity and date range
sop: On receipt, read the patient identity block on each record set.
Confirm the records cover the full requested date range without truncation.
Re-request where identity mismatches or the range is short and log the re-request.
Done when every received record set is confirmed matched and complete or re-requested.
verify: Compare the record date span against the requested range.
Pass when each accepted record set covers the requested range.

steps.title: Index the received records into the case evidence record
sop: Load each received APS into the case evidence index in the underwriting workstation.
Record the physician, receipt date and page count against each entry.
Confirm the record is visible against the case in the policy administration system.
Done when every received record is indexed and visible in both systems.
verify: Open the case evidence index and count indexed record sets.
Pass when the indexed count equals the received count.

steps.title: Mark the APS and prescription requirements satisfied
sop: Update each APS and prescription line on the requirements tracker to satisfied.
Record any physician who did not respond with the chase history.
Escalate non-responders for an alternative evidence decision.
Done when every request line is satisfied or escalated.
verify: Filter APS lines with neither satisfied nor escalated status.
Pass when that filter returns zero lines.

steps.title: Confirm the received records are usable for evaluation
sop: Read each indexed record for legibility and completeness of the clinical narrative.
Request supplementary records where key sections are missing or unreadable.
Record confirmation that the evidence is sufficient to evaluate.
Done when the records are confirmed usable or supplements are requested.
verify: Check each record set carries a usability confirmation.
Pass when no indexed record set is left unassessed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every conflict between application answers, MIB, RxDB, APS and exam results on this case
generic.In-scope period: From discrepancy identification until each item is closed before the decision point
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Discrepancy description, materiality classification, action taken and resolution held per item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed discrepancy count equals the discrepancy count originally listed
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Resolution notes stored on the case with the date and source of each answer
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unresolvable items logged with the underwriting treatment applied instead
generic.Test population: All life cases with two or more independent evidence sources on file
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any material discrepancy remains open at the decision point
generic.Exception handling path: Material items that cannot be cleared routed to a postpone or decline decision path
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No material evidence discrepancy left open on the case at the point of decision
generic.Evidence location: Discrepancy log in the case notes in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List every discrepancy across the evidence sources
sop: Read the application answers alongside the MIB, RxDB, APS and exam results.
List each point where two sources disagree with both statements quoted.
Record the source and date of each conflicting statement.
Done when every identified conflict is listed in the case discrepancy log.
verify: Cross-check the log against the undisclosed items flagged in the MIB assessment.
Pass when every flagged undisclosed item appears in the log.

steps.title: Classify each discrepancy as material or immaterial
sop: Assess whether each item could change the risk class or insurability.
Mark it material where it could and immaterial where it could not.
Record the reason for each immaterial classification.
Done when every logged item carries a classification and reason.
verify: Filter log items with no classification.
Pass when that filter returns zero items.

steps.title: Order the additional requirement needed to resolve each material item
sop: For each material item, identify the requirement that would settle it.
Order the APS clarification, specialist report or re-test through the vendor.
Log the order against the discrepancy line with its expected return date.
Done when every material item has a linked ordered requirement.
verify: Compare material item count against linked requirement count.
Pass when every material item has a linked requirement.

steps.title: Record applicant clarifications with question, date and answer
sop: Where clarification is sought from the applicant, record the exact question asked.
Record the date the question was put and through which channel.
Record the answer received verbatim against the discrepancy line.
Done when every applicant clarification carries question, date and answer.
verify: Check each clarification line for all three elements.
Pass when no clarification line is missing an element.

steps.title: Close each discrepancy with a resolution note
sop: Read the returned requirement or clarification for each open item.
Record the resolution and the evidence relied on to close it.
Mark the discrepancy closed on the log.
Done when every item is closed or explicitly carried as unresolved.
verify: Count closed items against the total logged items.
Pass when every item is closed or carries an unresolved marking.

steps.title: Confirm no material discrepancy is open before decision
sop: Filter the discrepancy log for material items with an open status.
Where any remain, hold the case and route it to postpone or decline consideration.
Record the pre-decision confirmation on the case in the policy administration system.
Done when the case shows zero open material discrepancies or is held.
verify: Re-run the material open filter immediately before the decision is entered.
Pass when the filter returns zero items.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every open underwriting requirement on the case across all vendors and the producer
generic.In-scope period: From requirement raise date until good-order status is set on the case
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor, order date, age in days and next chase date present on every open item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open item count on the tracker matches the open requirements in the policy system
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each chase logged with its date and the vendor or producer response recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items aged beyond the guideline maximum escalated with the close or withdraw outcome
generic.Test population: All in-flight life cases with at least one open requirement
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if good order is set while any requirement remains open on the tracker
generic.Exception handling path: Overaged requirements escalated to the Underwriting Director through the Life Underwriter
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requirement tracker showing dated follow-ups and zero open items at good-order status
generic.Evidence location: Requirements tracker on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Run the outstanding requirements report on the case
sop: Open the requirements tracker in the underwriting workstation for the case.
Run the outstanding requirements view showing vendor, order date and age in days.
Complete any line missing a vendor or order date.
Done when every open line shows vendor, order date and age in days.
verify: Filter open lines for a missing vendor or order date.
Pass when that filter returns zero lines.

steps.title: Chase requirements past SLA at the guideline cadence
sop: Identify open items reaching day seven, fourteen or twenty-one since order.
Contact the vendor for each and record the response.
Log the chase date and set the next chase date on the line.
Done when every item past SLA carries a chase logged at the correct cadence.
verify: Check chase dates against the seven, fourteen and twenty-one day cadence.
Pass when no past-SLA item has a missed cadence point.

steps.title: Notify the producer of applicant-dependent requirements
sop: Identify items depending on applicant action such as exams, forms or signatures.
Notify the producer of each with what the applicant must do and by when.
Log the notification date against the requirement line.
Done when every applicant-dependent item carries a logged producer notification.
verify: Compare applicant-dependent items against logged notifications.
Pass when every such item has a notification logged.

steps.title: Reconcile the tracker against the policy administration system requirements
sop: Open the case requirements view in the policy administration system.
Compare its open items against the workstation tracker line by line.
Correct either system where an item is missing or already satisfied.
Done when both systems show the same open requirement set.
verify: Compare open item counts across the two systems.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Escalate overaged requirements for a close or withdraw decision
sop: Identify items aged beyond the guideline maximum age.
Escalate each to the underwriting manager with the chase history attached.
Record the decision to continue, close or withdraw the case.
Done when every overaged item carries a recorded escalation outcome.
verify: Filter overaged items with no escalation outcome.
Pass when that filter returns zero items.

steps.title: Set good-order status only at zero open requirements
sop: Re-run the outstanding requirements view for the case.
Confirm the open item count is zero.
Set the case to good order and record the date and the setting user.
Done when good order is set with a zero open item count recorded.
verify: Re-run the open item count immediately after good order is set.
Pass when the count is zero at that moment.

generic.Defined scope/population: The single life or annuity case being triaged and the products applied for on it

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Issue age, face amount, product, state, grid cell and selected path recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Required evidence items listed equal those prescribed by the selected path

generic.Exception handling path: Cases the grid does not cover referred to the Life Underwriter for a manual path decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Triage record showing the grid cell, selected path and required evidence set
generic.Evidence location: Triage record on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Read application key data and locate the age and amount grid cell
sop: Read issue age, face amount, product and issue state from the application.
Locate the matching cell in the current age and amount grid.
Record the grid cell reference and the grid version used.
Done when the grid cell and version are recorded on the triage record.
verify: Re-look up the grid cell from the recorded application data.
Pass when the recorded cell matches the lookup.

steps.title: Determine the underwriting path for the case
sop: Read the paths available from the grid cell for this product and state.
Select accelerated, simplified issue or full traditional underwriting.
Record the selected path with the reason it was chosen.
Done when the selected path and its reason are recorded on the case.
verify: Compare the selected path against the paths permitted by the grid cell.
Pass when the selected path is permitted by the cell.

steps.title: Record automated engine knock-outs and route to full underwriting
sop: Read the automated engine result for the case in the policy administration system.
Where a knock-out fired, record the specific rule that fired.
Route the case to full traditional underwriting and note the reroute.
Done when every knock-out is recorded with its rule and the reroute applied.
verify: Compare the recorded rule against the engine decision log.
Pass when the recorded rule matches the engine log entry.

steps.title: List the required evidence set for the selected path
sop: Read the evidence prescribed by the selected path from the guideline.
List MIB, RxDB, MVR, paramed, labs, APS and financial items as required.
Record the list on the case as the required evidence set.
Done when the required evidence set is recorded against the case.
verify: Compare the recorded list against the path evidence prescription.
Pass when the two lists agree.

steps.title: Raise the required evidence items on the requirements tracker
sop: Open the requirements tracker for the case in the underwriting workstation.
Raise one open requirement line for each item on the required evidence set.
Record the target date for each line from the service standard.
Done when every evidence item has an open tracker line with a target date.
verify: Count tracker lines against the required evidence set count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Assign the case to the queue matching the selected path
sop: Select the underwriting queue that handles the selected path.
Assign the case to that queue in the policy administration system.
Record the target service standard applicable to that queue.
Done when the case is queued and the service standard is recorded.
verify: Check the assigned queue against the path recorded on the triage record.
Pass when the queue matches the selected path.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full evidence and forms set required for this case before assignment to an underwriter
generic.In-scope period: From triage evidence selection until the case is set ready for assignment
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each triage-selected evidence item marked present or missing with the validating date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items ticked present plus items listed missing equal the triage evidence set count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation record saved with the validating assistant name and date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing forms and illegible results logged with the re-request action recorded
generic.Test population: Every case reaching the completeness check before underwriter assignment
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the case is set complete while any required evidence item is missing
generic.Exception handling path: Cases with unobtainable items referred to the Life Underwriter for an assignment decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Completeness validation record with every required evidence item ticked before assignment
generic.Evidence location: Completeness validation record on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Tick each required evidence item against the triage-selected set
sop: Open the triage evidence set recorded on the case.
Check the case record for each item and mark it present or missing.
List every missing item on the validation record.
Done when every triage item is marked present or missing.
verify: Count marked items against the triage evidence set count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Confirm the application is signed and carries state-required forms
sop: Check the application for applicant and producer signatures and dates.
Confirm the state-required replacement and illustration forms are attached.
Request any missing form through the producer and log the request.
Done when the application is signed and all state forms are present or requested.
verify: Compare attached forms against the state form requirement list.
Pass when every state-required form is present or requested.

steps.title: Confirm the HIPAA authorisation is present, signed and unexpired
sop: Open the HIPAA authorisation attached to the case.
Confirm it is signed, dated and inside its validity window.
Request a replacement where it is missing or expired and log the request.
Done when a valid HIPAA authorisation is on file or has been requested.
verify: Check the authorisation signature date against the validity window.
Pass when the authorisation is current.

steps.title: Check exam and lab results for legibility and identity match
sop: Open each exam and lab result attached to the case.
Confirm all values are legible and no page is truncated.
Compare the identity block on each against the application applicant.
Done when every result is legible, complete and identity matched.
verify: Re-open one lab result and check identity and page completeness.
Pass when the checked result matches the applicant and is complete.

steps.title: Set the case to complete and ready for assignment
sop: Confirm the missing item list on the validation record is empty.
Set the case status to complete and ready for assignment.
Record the validating assistant name and the validation date.
Done when the case is set ready with validator and date recorded.
verify: Re-check the missing item list after the status is set.
Pass when the list is empty at the moment of setting.

steps.title: Accept or reject the completeness validation before assignment
sop: Read the validation record and the evidence index for the case.
Reject the validation where a required item is absent or unusable.
Record the accept or reject outcome on the validation record.
Done when the validation carries an accept or reject outcome.
verify: Confirm the outcome entry names the underwriter and the date.
Pass when the validation record carries a dated outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each impairment on this case carrying extra mortality beyond the table rating
generic.In-scope period: The run-off period of the flat extra as entered on the policy record
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Impairment, temporary or permanent flag, rate per thousand and duration recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flat extra keyed in the policy system matches the rate selected from the filed schedule
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed schedule reference and clinical basis stored on the case decision note
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Combined rating and extra above authority logged with the referral outcome recorded
generic.Test population: Every case where a flat extra is applied to the premium
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the extra is applied without a filed schedule reference or a stated duration
generic.Exception handling path: Extras beyond the underwriter authority referred to the Senior Underwriter before entry
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Flat extra per thousand and duration recorded in the policy system with a documented basis
generic.Evidence location: Policy record extras panel and the case decision note in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Identify the impairment requiring a flat extra on the case
sop: Read the evidence evaluation for impairments carrying extra mortality beyond table rating.
Record whether the mortality load for each is temporary or permanent.
State the clinical basis for treating it as an extra rather than a table rating.
Done when the impairment and its temporary or permanent nature are recorded.
verify: Trace the impairment to a finding in the case evidence evaluation.
Pass when the impairment appears in the recorded evidence findings.

steps.title: Select the flat extra rate from the filed schedule
sop: Open the filed flat extra schedule for the impairment and duration.
Select the rate per thousand applicable to this impairment and case age.
Record the schedule reference and rate selected on the case.
Done when the rate per thousand and its schedule reference are recorded.
verify: Re-look up the rate from the filed schedule using the impairment and duration.
Pass when the recorded rate matches the schedule.

steps.title: Confirm the extra basis with the Pricing Actuary where the schedule is silent
sop: Review impairments with no rate on the filed schedule.
Supply a rate basis drawn from the mortality assumptions for the product.
Record the supplied rate and its actuarial basis on the case.
Done when every schedule-silent impairment carries a supplied rate and basis.
verify: Compare referred impairments against those with a supplied basis.
Pass when every referred impairment has a recorded basis.

steps.title: Enter the extra and its run-off period into the policy system
sop: Open the extras panel on the policy record in the policy administration system.
Key the amount per thousand and the run-off period such as five dollars for five years.
Confirm the extra flows into the modal premium calculation.
Done when the extra and duration are keyed and reflected in the premium.
verify: Compare the keyed extra against the rate recorded on the case.
Pass when the keyed value matches the recorded rate and duration.

steps.title: Check the combined table rating and extra against authority
sop: Total the table rating and the flat extra into a combined rating position.
Compare it against the underwriter authority matrix entry.
Raise a referral where the combined position exceeds authority.
Done when the combined position is confirmed within authority or referred.
verify: Compare the combined position against the authority matrix limit.
Pass when the position is inside authority or a referral exists.

steps.title: Record the manual reference and clinical basis in the decision note
sop: Write the decision note stating the impairment, schedule reference and rate applied.
Record the clinical evidence that supports the extra.
Save the note to the case in the underwriting workstation.
Done when the note carries the schedule reference and the clinical basis.
verify: Read the note against the case evidence and the filed schedule.
Pass when both the reference and the basis are present and traceable.

steps.title: Review the applied flat extra before the offer is issued
sop: Read the extras panel against the case decision note and evidence.
Challenge any extra without a schedule reference or a stated duration.
Record the review outcome on the case.
Done when the applied extra carries a recorded review outcome.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the extra carries a dated review entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every debit and credit applied on this case rating worksheet

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Listed debits and credits sum to the net point total shown on the worksheet

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Credits reaching the manual cap logged with the capping treatment applied
generic.Test population: Every case where manual debits or credits are applied to reach a class
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any adjustment lacks a manual reference or credits exceed the manual cap
generic.Exception handling path: Adjustments outside manual guidance referred to the Senior Underwriter before the worksheet closes
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rating worksheet showing each debit and credit with manual reference and net point total
generic.Evidence location: Rating worksheet on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List each debit with its impairment and manual section
sop: Open the rating worksheet on the case in the underwriting workstation.
For every impairment carrying a debit, record the manual section and point value.
State the evidence source that established the impairment.
Done when every debit line carries impairment, section and point value.
verify: Compare the debit list against the impairment list in the evidence evaluation.
Pass when every rated impairment appears on the worksheet.

steps.title: List each credit with its manual basis
sop: Identify credits available for favourable build, treatment compliance or family history.
Record each credit with its manual section and point value.
State the evidence that qualifies the case for each credit.
Done when every credit line carries a manual basis and evidence reference.
verify: Trace each credit to a qualifying evidence item on the case.
Pass when every credit has a traceable qualifying evidence item.

steps.title: Sum debits and credits to a net point total
sop: Total the debit points and the credit points separately on the worksheet.
Compute the net point total from the two subtotals.
Record all three figures on the worksheet.
Done when debit total, credit total and net total are recorded.
verify: Re-add the individual lines and compare against the recorded totals.
Pass when the recomputed totals match the worksheet.

steps.title: Confirm credits do not exceed the manual credit cap
sop: Read the manual credit cap applicable to this product and class family.
Compare the total credit points against that cap.
Cap the credits and record the capping where the total exceeds it.
Done when credits are within the cap or the capping is recorded.
verify: Compare the applied credit total against the manual cap.
Pass when the applied total is at or below the cap.

steps.title: Convert the net points to a table rating and check against the impairment table
sop: Convert the net point total to a table rating using the manual conversion.
Compare the converted rating against the impairment table indication.
Record and explain any difference between the two.
Done when the converted rating and any difference are recorded.
verify: Re-run the conversion from the recorded net point total.
Pass when the recorded rating matches the conversion.

steps.title: Confirm no adjustment references a prohibited factor
sop: Read each debit and credit line for the characteristic it is based on.
Confirm none is based on a genetic test result or another prohibited factor.
Record the confirmation statement on the worksheet.
Done when the worksheet carries an explicit prohibited-factor confirmation.
verify: Trace each adjustment to a permitted underwriting characteristic.
Pass when no adjustment traces to a prohibited factor.

steps.title: Obtain reviewer sign-off on the rating worksheet
sop: Read the worksheet against the evidence evaluation and the manual sections cited.
Challenge any adjustment without a manual reference or supporting evidence.
Sign off the worksheet or return it for correction.
Done when the worksheet carries a reviewer sign-off or a return note.
verify: Confirm the sign-off entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the worksheet carries a dated sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: The proposed insured on this case being assigned a mortality class and table rating
generic.In-scope period: The evidence set current at the point the class is entered on the policy record
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Tobacco status, class, table rating and each preferred criterion result recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Class keyed in the policy system matches the class recorded on the rating worksheet
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Class assignment saved with the manual and actuarial table version referenced
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Preferred criteria not met logged with the class step-down applied
generic.Test population: Every case reaching classification in the underwriting workstation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a preferred class is assigned with any preferred criterion unevidenced
generic.Exception handling path: Classes outside the actuarial table indication referred to the Pricing Actuary before entry
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Class and table rating in the policy system with every preferred criterion evidenced
generic.Evidence location: Classification record on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Confirm tobacco status from cotinine and application declaration
sop: Read the cotinine result from the lab report on the case.
Compare it against the tobacco declaration on the application.
Record the tobacco status that the evidence supports.
Done when the tobacco status is recorded with its evidence basis.
verify: Check the recorded status against the cotinine result.
Pass when the status is consistent with the lab evidence.

steps.title: Test every preferred criterion for the class family
sop: List the preferred criteria for the product covering build, blood pressure, lipids and family history.
Test each against the evidence and record met or not met with the value used.
Note any criterion that cannot be tested from the evidence held.
Done when every preferred criterion carries a tested result.

verify: Re-add the component amounts and compare against the recorded total.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the record.

steps.title: Compare the total against the retention limit for age and class band
sop: Read the retention limit for the issue age and class band from the treaty.
Compare the total amount at risk against that limit.
Record the excess amount or record that the case is within retention.
Done when the retention comparison result is recorded.
verify: Re-look up the retention limit for the recorded age and class band.
Pass when the limit used matches the treaty table.

steps.title: Test the case against the automatic binding limit and jumbo limit
sop: Read the automatic binding limit and jumbo limit from the treaty.
Test the amount at risk and the total line against each limit.
Record whether both limits are satisfied.
Done when both limit tests are recorded with their results.
verify: Compare the tested amounts against the treaty limit values.
Pass when both tests are recorded with the correct limit values.

steps.title: Check the impairment against the treaty facultative-only and excluded lists
sop: Read the impairments recorded on the case evidence evaluation.
Compare each against the treaty facultative-only and excluded lists.
Record any match and the routing it forces.
Done when every impairment is checked against both treaty lists.
verify: Compare checked impairments against the evidence evaluation list.
Pass when every recorded impairment has been checked.

steps.title: Record the screening outcome on the case
sop: Select the outcome of within retention, automatic cession or facultative referral required.
Record the outcome with the limits and lists that drove it.
Raise the facultative referral task where the outcome requires it.
Done when the outcome is recorded and any referral task is raised.
verify: Compare the recorded outcome against the limit test results.
Pass when the outcome follows from the recorded tests.

steps.title: Mirror the screening result to the policy administration system
sop: Open the reinsurance panel on the case in the policy administration system.
Record the cession position and the treaty applied.
Confirm the workstation and policy system show the same position.
Done when both systems show the same cession position.
verify: Compare the cession position in both systems.
Pass when the two agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force, pending and recently declined coverage on the proposed insured across carriers
generic.In-scope period: Current in-force coverage plus applications within the lookback for declined and withdrawn
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Carrier, face amount, status and source recorded for every coverage line
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of coverage lines equals the total line exposure stated on the worksheet
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: MIB and internal in-force extracts attached with their retrieval dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage exceeding jumbo or maximum insurable amount flagged with the review raised
generic.Test population: Every case entering financial underwriting review
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any coverage line lacks a carrier or a source reference
generic.Exception handling path: Undocumented coverage found on MIB queried with the applicant before the total is finalised
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Total line exposure worksheet listing in-force, pending and declined coverage by carrier
generic.Evidence location: Total line exposure worksheet on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List in-force coverage from the application, MIB and internal records
sop: Read the application disclosure of other coverage on the life.
Read the MIB return and the internal in-force records for the same life.
List every in-force policy with carrier, face amount and source.
Done when every in-force line is listed with carrier, amount and source.
verify: Compare the listed lines against the internal in-force extract.
Pass when every internal in-force policy appears on the list.

steps.title: Add pending applications disclosed or found via MIB
sop: Read the application for pending coverage disclosures.
Read the MIB return for pending application activity at other carriers.
Add each pending line with carrier and amount applied for.
Done when every pending application is listed with carrier and amount.
verify: Compare listed pending lines against the MIB pending entries.
Pass when every MIB pending entry appears on the list.

steps.title: Add coverage declined or withdrawn within the lookback
sop: Identify coverage applied for and then declined or withdrawn in the lookback period.
Record each with carrier, amount and the outcome.
Note the source that revealed each entry.
Done when every declined or withdrawn line is recorded with its outcome.
verify: Compare recorded entries against the LexisNexis Risk prior-application search.
Pass when every search hit is represented on the worksheet.

steps.title: Sum to a total line exposure on the worksheet
sop: Total the in-force, pending and applied-for amounts on the worksheet.
Record the total line exposure figure.
Show the components so the total can be traced.
Done when the total line exposure and its components are recorded.
verify: Re-add the component amounts and compare against the stated total.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the worksheet.

steps.title: Compare the total against the jumbo limit and maximum insurable amount
sop: Read the treaty jumbo limit and the case maximum insurable amount.
Compare the total line exposure against each.
Record the comparison result against both limits.
Done when both comparisons are recorded with their results.
verify: Re-look up the jumbo limit from the treaty in force.
Pass when the limit used matches the treaty.

steps.title: Flag the case for financial underwriting review where a limit is exceeded
sop: Where either limit is exceeded, flag the case for financial underwriting review.
Record the limit breached and the amount by which it is exceeded.
Hold the case from offer until the review completes.
Done when the flag, breach detail and hold are recorded.
verify: Compare the flag status against the recorded limit comparisons.
Pass when every breach carries a flag and a hold.

generic.Defined scope/population: This case ownership and beneficiary structure where a complexity trigger applies
generic.In-scope period: From trigger identification until the specialist recommendation is logged
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger, ownership chart, specialist opinion, conditions and recommendation recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Conditions recorded by the specialist all appear as case requirements
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consultation note stored on the case with the specialist name and consultation date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Structures the specialist will not accept logged with the restructure or decline outcome
generic.Test population: Every case with trust, split-dollar, financing, foreign national or unrelated beneficiary features
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the case proceeds to offer without the specialist recommendation logged
generic.Exception handling path: Specialist declines routed to the Underwriting Director for the final case action
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consultation note recording the trigger, opinion and resulting recommendation
generic.Evidence location: Specialist consultation note on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Record the complexity trigger that requires consultation
sop: Read the ownership and beneficiary structure recorded on the case.
Identify which trigger applies from trust, split-dollar, financing, foreign national or unrelated beneficiary.
Record the trigger and the facts that establish it.
Done when the trigger and its supporting facts are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded trigger against the consultation trigger list.
Pass when the trigger appears on that list.

steps.title: Package the ownership chart and funding source for the specialist
sop: Assemble the ownership chart, beneficiary designations and funding source documents.
Add the application, financial evidence and the underwriting question being asked.
Send the package to the financial underwriting specialist queue.
Done when the package is sent and its contents are listed on the case.
verify: Compare the package contents against the consultation checklist.
Pass when no checklist item is missing.

steps.title: Record the specialist opinion on insurable interest and funding
sop: Receive the specialist response on the case.
Record the opinion on insurable interest, ownership legitimacy and funding acceptability.
Record any part of the structure the specialist regards as unacceptable.
Done when the opinion is recorded against all three questions.
verify: Check the recorded opinion covers insurable interest, ownership and funding.
Pass when all three are addressed.

steps.title: Raise the specialist conditions as case requirements
sop: List the conditions the specialist requires such as trust documents or corporate resolutions.
Raise each as an open requirement on the case tracker with a due date.
Record the link between each requirement and the specialist condition.
Done when every specialist condition exists as a case requirement.
verify: Compare specialist conditions against open requirement lines.
Pass when every condition has a matching requirement.

steps.title: Log the accept, restructure or decline recommendation
sop: Record the specialist recommendation of accept, restructure or decline.
State what must change where restructure is recommended.
Save the consultation note to the case in the underwriting workstation.
Done when the recommendation and any restructure requirement are recorded.
verify: Read the recommendation against the recorded specialist opinion.
Pass when the recommendation follows from the opinion.

steps.title: Approve the case action arising from the consultation
sop: Read the trigger, opinion, conditions and recommendation on the case.
Approve the case action or require further work before it proceeds.
Record the approval with name and date in the policy administration system.
Done when the case action carries a recorded approval.
verify: Confirm the approval entry names the approver and the date.
Pass when the consultation carries a dated approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: The proposed insured verified income and net worth used to set insurable capacity
generic.In-scope period: Verified income for the two most recent tax years and current-dated net worth
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Age band multiple, verified income, net worth, in-force deduction and residual capacity
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Residual capacity equals computed capacity less in-force coverage on the worksheet
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Capacity worksheet saved to the case with the guideline table version cited
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests above residual capacity logged as excessive with the action recorded
generic.Test population: Every case where financial justification of the amount applied for is required
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the worksheet omits the multiple applied or the in-force deduction
generic.Exception handling path: Cases where no guideline multiple fits referred to the Pricing Actuary for a basis
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Worksheet showing the multiple applied, capacity computed and in-force coverage deducted
generic.Evidence location: Maximum insurable amount worksheet on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Select the income multiple for the insured age band
sop: Read the insured issue age from the application.
Locate the income multiple for that age band in the financial underwriting guideline table.
Record the multiple and the guideline table version on the worksheet.
Done when the multiple and table version are recorded.
verify: Re-look up the multiple for the recorded age band.
Pass when the recorded multiple matches the table.

steps.title: Compute income-based capacity in Microsoft Excel
sop: Enter the verified earned income figure into the capacity worksheet.
Multiply it by the selected age band multiple.
Record the income-based capacity result.
Done when income-based capacity is computed and recorded.
verify: Recompute income times multiple from the recorded inputs.
Pass when the recomputed capacity matches the worksheet.

steps.title: Compute net-worth-based capacity where the purpose is estate planning
sop: Read the stated purpose of the insurance from the case.
Where estate planning applies, apply the estate growth guideline to the verified net worth.
Record the net-worth-based capacity and the growth assumption used.
Done when net-worth capacity is computed or recorded as not applicable.
verify: Check the growth assumption against the guideline value.
Pass when the assumption matches the guideline.

steps.title: Confirm the capacity basis with the Pricing Actuary where the guideline does not fit
sop: Review cases where no guideline multiple or growth basis applies.
Supply an alternative capacity basis with its actuarial justification.
Record the supplied basis on the worksheet.
Done when every referred case carries a supplied capacity basis.
verify: Compare referred cases against those with a supplied basis.
Pass when every referred case has a recorded basis.

steps.title: Deduct existing in-force coverage to reach residual capacity
sop: Take the greater of the income-based and net-worth-based capacity.
Subtract the in-force coverage total from the line exposure worksheet.
Record the residual capacity figure.
Done when residual capacity is recorded with its deduction shown.
verify: Recompute residual capacity from the recorded capacity and in-force total.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the worksheet.

steps.title: Record whether the amount applied for is justified
sop: Compare the residual capacity against the amount applied for.
Record justified, partially justified or excessive with the difference stated.
Raise the amount reduction action where the request is excessive.
Done when the justification conclusion and any action are recorded.
verify: Compare the conclusion against the residual capacity and applied amount.
Pass when the conclusion follows from the two figures.

steps.title: Review the capacity worksheet before it drives terms
sop: Read the worksheet for multiple, capacity computation and in-force deduction.
Challenge any capacity built on unverified income or net worth.
Record the review outcome on the worksheet.
Done when the worksheet carries a recorded review outcome.
verify: Confirm the review entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when the worksheet carries a dated review entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: The policy structure offered on this case where an anti-selection risk has been identified
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the risk until the structure flows into the offer terms
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named risk, structural response, revised amount and contestability confirmation recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reduced face amount matches the justified capacity computed in financial underwriting
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Structure decision saved on the case with author, date and rationale
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Structures the broker rejects logged with the resulting case action recorded
generic.Test population: Every case where anti-selection screening returned a monitor or escalate outcome
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the structure decision does not name the anti-selection risk it mitigates
generic.Exception handling path: Structures altering contestability or suicide provisions referred to the Senior Underwriter
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Structure decision naming the anti-selection risk and the mitigating change made
generic.Evidence location: Policy structure decision on the case in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Name the anti-selection risk being mitigated
sop: Read the anti-selection screening outcome recorded on the case.
Name the specific risk covering financing, third-party interest, over-insurance or replacement churn.
Record the evidence that establishes the risk.
Done when the named risk and its evidence are recorded.
verify: Trace the named risk to the screening outcome on the case.
Pass when the risk appears in the screening record.

steps.title: Decide the structural response to the risk
sop: Consider reducing the face amount, changing ownership, adding a rider restriction or splitting coverage.
Select the response that addresses the named risk with least disruption.
Record the selected response and the options rejected.
Done when the structural response is selected and recorded.
verify: Read the response against the named risk.
Pass when the response directly addresses the named risk.

steps.title: Set the reduced face amount to the justified capacity
sop: Where reducing the amount, read the justified capacity from the financial underwriting worksheet.
Set the reduced face amount to that capacity figure.
Record the reduction and its capacity basis on the case.
Done when the reduced amount matches the justified capacity and is recorded.
verify: Compare the reduced face amount against the worksheet capacity figure.
Pass when the two figures agree.

steps.title: Confirm contestability and suicide provisions are unaltered
sop: Read the contestability and suicide provisions applicable in the issue state.
Confirm the chosen structure does not alter either provision.
Record the confirmation on the structure decision.
Done when the confirmation statement is recorded on the case.
verify: Compare the structure against the state provision requirements.
Pass when neither provision is altered by the structure.

steps.title: Record the structure decision and rationale on the case
sop: Write the decision stating the named risk, response chosen and reason.
Save it to the case in the underwriting workstation with author and date.
Confirm the decision is visible against the case in the policy administration system.
Done when the decision is saved and visible in both systems.
verify: Open the case in the policy administration system and locate the decision.
Pass when the decision is retrievable from both systems.

steps.title: Confirm the structure flows into the offer terms
sop: Read the draft offer terms against the recorded structure decision.
Require correction where the terms do not reflect the structure.
Record the confirmation on the structure decision record.
Done when the offer terms reflect the structure and the confirmation is recorded.
verify: Compare the offer terms against the structure decision.
Pass when the terms match the decided structure.
